name: Ratchet Luncheon
original_name: ラチェット・ランチョン
source:
Ratchet Luncheon is a shopkeeper working in a Weapon Shop in the town of Ice from the Free Cities Alliance. He is a muscular and tall man with a bald and a pigtail. He also has a huge scar in his face. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Rachett_Luncheon]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
